newsitem.title: UK: UK meals and feeds mostly unchanged, quiet.
newsitem.headline: UK meals and feeds mostly unchanged, quiet.

text.p: UK meals and feeds prices were mostly unchanged on Wednesday with virtually no business reported.
"There have a lot of enquires, but none of it has turned into business," said one broker.
However, one trade was reported when citrus pulp pellets fetched 79 stg a tonne ex-store Plymouth.
High protein soymeal was offered around one stg up for spot positions with the summer months unchanged while across the new year prices were one stg down.
The remainder of the market was unchanged.
